title: BalanceInquiryResponse
description: Balance Inquiry Response should be in ISO XML Standard format(camt.052.001.02). refer this link for more details- https://www.iso20022.org/catalogue-messages/iso-20022-messages-archive?business-domain%5B0%5D=1&search=camt.052.001.02

Ccy.description: Currency code. Passed as the tag attribute.

ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount_Simple.description: A number of monetary units specified in an active or a historic currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217. The number of fractional digits should be 5.

BaseOneRate.description: Total Digits allowed is 11 and upto 10 decimal places allowed.

CreditDebitCode.description:
Specifies if an operation is an increase or a decrease.
*`CRDT_credit`-Operation is an increase.
*`DBIT_debit`-Operation is a decrease.

DecimalNumber.description: Total digits 18 is allowed. And upto 17 decimal places allowed

ISODate.description: A particular point in the progression of time in a calendar year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. This representation is defined in "XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition - W3C Recommendation 28 October 2004" which is aligned with ISO 8601.

ImpliedCurrencyAndAmount.description: Total digts 18 are allowed. And Upto 5 fractional places

Max35Text.description: Specifies a character string with a maximum length of 35 characters.

Max70Text.description: Specifies a character string with a maximum length of 70characters.

OrganisationIdentification4.description: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

BICOrBEI.description: Code allocated to a financial institution or non financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

Othr.description: Unique identification of an organisation, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme.

OrganisationIdentificationSchemeName1Cho.description: Either of Code or Proprietary is required

Nm.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

Id.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of a party. Should pass either OrgId or PrvtId for organisation and private respectively.

CtryOfRes.description: Country in which a person resides (the place of a person's home). In the case of a company, it is the country from which the affairs of that company are directed.

PercentageRate.description: Total 11 digits allowed. Upto 10 decimal places allowed

PostalAddress6.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

AdrLine.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services, presented in free format text.

AdrTp.description:
Identifies the nature of the postal address.

ADDR : Address is the complete postal address.

PBOX : Address is a postal office (PO) box.

HOME : Address is the home address.

BIZZ : Address is the business address.

MLTO : Address is the address to which mail is sent.

DLVY : Address is the address to which delivery is to take place.

BldgNb.description: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

CtrySubDvsn.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county.

Dept.description: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

PstCd.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

StrtNm.description: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

SubDept.description: Identification of a sub-division of a large organisation or building.

TwnNm.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.
